description:
Turn the entire iPhone display into a glass of fluid that moves with convincing weight and depth.

Tilt your phone left or right. The surface remains level with the world, liquid spills only when it reaches the top rim, and carbonation rises against gravity. Foam, reflections, and highlights react continuously to motion.

• Full-screen liquid simulation
• Sideways tilt and spill physics
• Tap to switch between beer and cola
• Refill the glass at any time
• No ads, accounts, analytics, or tracking

A focused physics toy and visual joke to enjoy with friends.
promotionalText: Your iPhone becomes a glass, complete with responsive foam and rising carbonation.
